properties.title: Bangladesh: Floods and Landslides, Summer 2015
properties.description: Since June 24, torrential rains have set off flash floods and landslides in the low-lying areas in the south-eastern districts of Cox’ Bazar, Bandarban and Chittagong. Tropical Cyclone Komen hit on July 31, affecting more than 1.5 million people across these same coastal districts.

properties.title: Bangladesh Flooding, May 2016
properties.description: In Bangladesh, Tropical Cyclone Roanu made landfall on 21 May 2016, causing floods, landslides and submerging homes. Initial reports indicate at least 24 are deceased and up to half a million people have been affected.

properties.title: Bangladesh Floods and Landslides
properties.description: Cyclone Mora struck the eastern coast of Bangladesh on 30 May. The Category 1 hurricane brought powerful winds and torrential rain that have triggered mudslides and flooding.
